biggest_catch: The referral reward is specifically for new members only — the friend's qualification details live behind the linked Terms and Conditions rather than on the landing page itself.
catches: The referred person must open a new TruChoice personal checking account and, within 60 days, enroll in eStatements AND complete direct deposits totaling $500 or more OR twelve or more debit card transactions (excluding ATM transactions).
Reward is specifically for new members only; referred person must register via the referral email/social link.
Referrer can earn up to $500 in Visa Reward Cards per calendar year.
Only one referrer can receive a reward for each referred person.
Visa Reward Cards are subject to cardholder terms; both parties have 90 days from card issue to spend the gift card.
Rewards may be reported as income to the IRS.
Offer can be changed at any time without notice.

Invite friends/family by email or social media with your personal referral link.
Your friend registers via your link, opens a new personal checking account, and meets the requirements within 60 days (eStatements + $500+ direct deposits or 12+ debit transactions).
